Two columns

Alpha begins the left column. The left column tells of the garden in spring, when the beans climb their poles and the snails come out after rain. Keep the lettuce under netting.

Beta continues on the left. Water in the evening, never at noon. The compost wants turning every fortnight and a little lime in winter.

Gamma opens the right column. The right column is about the kitchen: bread rises best in the airing cupboard, and the oven runs hot on its left side.

Delta ends the right column. Salt the water for pasta like the sea, and keep the stock in the freezer in labelled jars.
